rule_name: Unknown role block
description: Unknown role must be blocked.
validator_message: Unknown role cannot execute workflows.
llm_prompt_instruction: Do not generate executable workflows for unknown roles.
healing_guidance: Ask user to authenticate with a known role.

rule_name: LLM must not invent tools
description: If a tool is not in the registry, block execution.
validator_message: Workflow contains a tool that is not in registry.
llm_prompt_instruction: Use only registered tools from retrieved context.
healing_guidance: Replace hallucinated tool with registered tool or capability request.

rule_name: Missing governance rule escalation
description: If a required governance rule is missing, escalate to governance owner.
validator_message: Required governance rule is missing.
llm_prompt_instruction: Do not assume missing policy permission.
healing_guidance: Escalate to governance owner.

rule_name: No passing candidate means no execution
description: If no candidate passes validation, do not execute.
validator_message: No workflow candidate passed semantic validation.
llm_prompt_instruction: Generate alternatives or ask clarification; never execute failed candidate.
healing_guidance: Regenerate candidates or escalate.

rule_name: Allow decomposed approved tool path
description: If request can be decomposed using approved tools, allow decomposed workflow generation.
validator_message: Approved decomposed workflow path exists.
llm_prompt_instruction: Generate smaller validated workflow steps.
healing_guidance: Use decomposed registered tools.

rule_name: Capability request for missing path
description: If no approved tool path exists, create capability request.
validator_message: No approved tool path exists; capability request required.
llm_prompt_instruction: Use capability.create_capability_request instead of inventing tools.
healing_guidance: Create capability request.

rule_name: High-risk workflow human approval
description: High-risk workflows require request_human_approval.
validator_message: High-risk workflow requires human approval.
llm_prompt_instruction: Insert approval.request_human_approval for high-risk workflow.
healing_guidance: Add human approval step.

rule_name: Critical workflow audit
description: Critical workflows require audit.write_audit_log.
validator_message: Critical workflow requires audit log.
llm_prompt_instruction: Append audit.write_audit_log for critical workflow.
healing_guidance: Add audit log step.

rule_name: Sensitive field redaction
description: Sensitive fields must not be passed to LLM.
validator_message: Sensitive fields cannot be sent to LLM.
llm_prompt_instruction: Redact sensitive fields from prompt grounding.
healing_guidance: Remove secrets and sensitive personal data.

rule_name: Secrets never in workflows
description: API keys, tokens, and passwords must never appear in generated workflows.
validator_message: Generated workflow contains secret material.
llm_prompt_instruction: Never include raw secrets in workflow JSON.
healing_guidance: Replace secret with key reference.

rule_name: Score cannot override critical failure
description: Validation score alone cannot override critical rule failure.
validator_message: Critical rule failure cannot be overridden by score.
llm_prompt_instruction: Do not rank failed critical candidates as executable.
healing_guidance: Regenerate or escalate.

rule_name: Schema validity weight
description: schema validity weight = 0.20.
validator_message: Schema validity scoring weight must be 0.20.
llm_prompt_instruction: Use schema validity weight 0.20.
healing_guidance: Correct scorer configuration.

rule_name: Tool validity weight
description: tool validity weight = 0.20.
validator_message: Tool validity scoring weight must be 0.20.
llm_prompt_instruction: Use tool validity weight 0.20.
healing_guidance: Correct scorer configuration.

rule_name: Parameter completeness weight
description: parameter completeness weight = 0.20.
validator_message: Parameter completeness scoring weight must be 0.20.
llm_prompt_instruction: Use parameter completeness weight 0.20.
healing_guidance: Correct scorer configuration.

rule_name: RBAC compliance weight
description: RBAC compliance weight = 0.15.
validator_message: RBAC scoring weight must be 0.15.
llm_prompt_instruction: Use RBAC compliance weight 0.15.
healing_guidance: Correct scorer configuration.

rule_name: Policy compliance weight
description: policy compliance weight = 0.15.
validator_message: Policy scoring weight must be 0.15.
llm_prompt_instruction: Use policy compliance weight 0.15.
healing_guidance: Correct scorer configuration.

rule_name: Process order compliance weight
description: process order compliance weight = 0.05.
validator_message: Process order scoring weight must be 0.05.
llm_prompt_instruction: Use process-order compliance weight 0.05.
healing_guidance: Correct scorer configuration.

rule_name: Risk control compliance weight
description: risk-control compliance weight = 0.05.
validator_message: Risk-control scoring weight must be 0.05.
llm_prompt_instruction: Use risk-control compliance weight 0.05.
healing_guidance: Correct scorer configuration.

rule_name: Mandatory checks required
description: Candidate can execute only if all mandatory checks pass.
validator_message: Mandatory checks did not pass.
llm_prompt_instruction: Do not execute candidate with mandatory check failure.
healing_guidance: Regenerate candidate.

rule_name: Select highest scoring passed candidate
description: Passed candidate with highest score is selected.
validator_message: Select highest scoring passed candidate.
llm_prompt_instruction: Rank only candidates that passed validation.
healing_guidance: Filter blocked candidates before ranking.

rule_name: Tie-breaker rule
description: Tie-breaker: lowest risk, fewer unnecessary steps, earliest generated candidate.
validator_message: Tie-breaker must prefer lower risk and simpler workflow.
llm_prompt_instruction: Apply deterministic tie-breaker.
healing_guidance: Correct ranker configuration.
